name: Amazon LGB3 Fulfillment Center Eastvale CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entry. Amazon Tours guidance states drivers/visitors enter at the main guard post at the intersection of Goodman Way and The Station; the signalized main driveway (NW corner, monument sign '4950 Goodman Way') is the single controlled checkpoint into a fully fenced campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Amazon explicitly references a staffed 'main guard post' at the entrance. Booth structure not individually resolvable in overhead imagery (entrance canopy/landscaping obscures it) and the truck side faces I-15 with no Street View, so flagged uncertain, but staffed-guard operation is corroborated by the operator.
fieldNotes.guardShackEvidence: Web (events.amazontours.com / help.amazontours.com LGB3): 'enter at the main guard post, which is at the intersection of Goodman Way and The Station.'
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal truck court between the FC south face and the east drop yard provides ample inside-the-gate queue/staging room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the Goodman Way entrance around to the east-side dock apron and drop yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single controlled entrance off Goodman Way serves both in and out; no separate out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 in / 2 out at the main signalized driveway; exact lane split partly obscured by landscaping — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and large internal truck court leave clear paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door banks run the full east wall and the full south wall with trailers backed in; total well into the 50+ band (est. ~120 doors across both faces).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer drop yard runs the entire east side between the building and I-15, dozens of trailers parked nose-out in rows plus yard hostlers staging — clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (east wall + south wall) operate as physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Eastvale is dense Inland Empire metro logistics fabric (Goodman Logistics Center, adjacent Costco and multiple big-box DCs) bordering I-15 — Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: LGB3 is one FC building (connected to a west office annex by a pedestrian bridge over Goodman Way); the large gray-roof building to the south is a separate tenant, not counted here.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; I-15 freeway bounds the east edge.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~47 acres from the traced perimeter polygon (building + west parking + east drop yard).
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Door/trailer counts are honest overhead estimates from z19-z20 crops; ranges are confident but exact integers approximate.
